author: reek
body: Proves an AUTHORED multi-effect card works through the full AI cast path (not just manual resolve). Char-like spell = two authored StaticAbilities: deal 3 damage to target creature, and deal 1 to the caster... modeled here as deal 2 to target creature + gain 2 life. The pilot casts it, ai-pick-targets points the damage at the opponent's creature, and apply-ability-list applies BOTH abilities in order. This is the workflow for future multi-effect cards: list the abilities, done.
